text:
For Crypto, this was basically a retest of the 10/10 panic, but over a more deliberate period.  Sentiment is beyond wiped clean.

We've hit the 50wma and the weekly cycle should start fresh.  Any good upside price separation from the lows should put a line in the bull/bear market narrative at the recent lows.  Bitcoin would have no business revisiting it later this month or in Dec.
